title: When every line is No Charge the dialog says to convert instead
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, with its own labor rate of $120.00 an hour.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, in status Approved, billable, with line 1 already No Charge under Goodwill and line 2 billable.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Open line 2's three-dots menu.
  3. Click "Mark as No Charge".
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens.

Step 2:

  • The menu shows "Mark as No Charge".

Step 3:

  • The dialog shows the hint "All lines are No Charge. To close without an invoice and get the NO CHARGE document, convert the work order instead."

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order)

  • S12-R10: “If every line of the work order is No Charge, the work order still invoices at $0.00 as a billable work order (one invoice, nothing owed, as a $0 invoice is paid today); the dialog of S12-R2 shows the hint "All lines are No Charge. To close without an invoice and get the NO CHARGE document, convert the work order instead." The whole-work-order path (Stories 2 and 3) is unchanged.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “All lines of the work order are No Charge | "All lines are No Charge. To close without an invoice and get the NO CHARGE document, convert the work order instead." | Hint in the Mark as No Charge dialog (S12-R10)”
